briefdescription.para: Clamp software timer period into valid range [1, INT32_MAX].

memberdef.argsstring: (SYN_Timer *timer, uint32_t period_ms, bool periodic, SYN_TimerCallback callback, void *user_data)
memberdef.name: syn_timer_init

detaileddescription.para: The timer is created in the stopped state. Call syn_timer_start() to begin counting.

parameterdescription.para: true for repeating timer, false for one-shot.
Function called on expiry (may be NULL if using polling).
User context pointer passed to callback.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the target tick to now + period_ms and marks the timer active.

briefdescription.para: Stop the timer. It will not fire until started again.
Change the timer's period. Takes effect on next start or next periodic reload.
Atomically check expiry, re-arm or disarm timer, and snapshot callback pointers.

parameterdescription.para: Optional output pointer receiving snapshot of callback function.
Optional output pointer receiving snapshot of callback user_data.

simplesect.para: true if timer expired on this check, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Poll whether the timer has expired.

detaileddescription.para: If expired and periodic, the timer is automatically re-armed. If expired and one-shot, the timer is stopped.
This can be used instead of (or in addition to) the callback.

simplesect.para: true if the timer has expired since the last check.

detaileddescription.para: Checks each timer for expiry and calls its callback if set. Call this from your main loop, a scheduler task, or a periodic ISR.

parameterdescription.para: Number of timers in the array.

briefdescription.para: Get the remaining time until the next expiry.
Get the earliest expiry tick among a set of active timers.

detaileddescription.para: Scans the timer array and returns the current tick (now) if any active timer has already expired, or the minimum target_tick among active timers whose deadline is in the future (clamping UINT32_MAX to UINT32_MAX - 1 to avoid sentinel aliasing). Returns UINT32_MAX only when no timers are active.

parameterdescription.para: Number of timers in the array.

simplesect.para: Current tick if any timer is due now, earliest future expiry tick, or UINT32_MAX if no timers are active.
